text:
Come, put your hand into me...

        Come, put your hand into me


through the deep dark vein of my flesh.

Inside, your arm will curdle

        with my shadow;

it will become night-stone,

dry root of

        blood...


The fountain of my chest coagulated,

to ask for help

it will rise

        to my throat.


Deny it if it is life!

Drive your arm deeper into me!...

        Cross me with it!


Pierce me!

Though it cost me the tree of my body,

        lead me to you, death.

translation.title: Come, Put Your Hand Into Me...
translation.editorial_note: The catalog title differs, but the visible body begins 'Come, put your hand into me'; this entry preserves that body.
